about_d: BasaChai connects tenants and owners in Dhamrai directly. Every listing shows rent, service charge and advance separately, so you know the real monthly cost up front. Posting is free.
address_hint: This isn't shown publicly. You share it when a tenant calls.
al_changes: A moderator asked for changes to "{x}".
al_expired: "{x}" has expired, so it is hidden from search.
al_expiring: "{x}" expires in {n} days. Confirm it is still available.
bad_code: That code is not right. Try the current code.
bad_credentials: That number and password don't match. Try again or contact support.
csrf_failed: Refresh the page and try again.
delete_d: Your account and personal details are removed. Your listings are archived. This cannot be undone.
draft_legal: Draft: to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
empty_d: Changing one filter may show more homes.
f_line: BasaChai: piloting in Dhamrai. Posting is free.
f_photo_credit: Photos on demo listings are free-licence samples and do not show the actual homes.

hero_sub: Rental homes in Dhamrai. Rent, service charge and advance are each listed separately.
hero_title: Find a home. Talk to the owner directly.
hidden_banner: A moderator has hidden this listing from search.
how1_d: Pick all of Dhamrai or a specific area.
how2_d: Service charge and other bills are added to the rent to show the total.
how3_d: No broker fee. No login needed to see the number.
load_error: Homes could not be loaded. Try again.
loc_d: The owner shares the exact address by phone. Only the area is shown here.

m_activation: Owners with a first live listing
m_reports: Reports answered within one business day
mod_review: Usually reviewed within one business day
name: Your name
name_length: Enter a name of 2 to 60 characters
not_found: This listing is no longer available.
one_time_head: Paid once when you move in
others_hint: Such as a gas bill or a refundable deposit. Leave the amount blank if it varies.

pass_common: This password is too common. Choose another.
pass_err: Password must be at least 8 characters
pay_warn: Don't send any money before you visit.
ph_desc: What's nearby, light and air, and so on
phone_err: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number, like 01712345678
phone_readonly: The mobile number cannot be changed.
phone_taken: This number already has an account. Sign in instead.
photo_failed: This photo could not be uploaded. Try again.
photo_limit: A listing can have at most 20 photos.
photo_too_large: Photos must be 10 MB or smaller.
photo_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
photos_hint: Add at least 3 photos, up to 20. Location data is removed from every photo.
post_sub: Posting is free. A moderator reviews every listing before it goes live.
preview_banner: Preview: this listing is "{s}", so tenants cannot see it.
privacy_1: We keep only your name, mobile number and password (hashed).
privacy_2: Full addresses are stored encrypted and never shown publicly.
privacy_3: Location and all other metadata are removed from photos.
privacy_4: IP addresses and device IDs are stored only as hashes.
privacy_5: You can delete your account at any time from the account page.
report_sent: Report sent. A moderator will review it within one business day.
reset_used: This link has expired or was already used.
restricted: This account cannot post listings. Contact support.
reveal_limited: You have viewed many numbers recently. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
review_note: A moderator usually reviews within one business day. You'll see the result on My listings.
safety_1: Never send an advance, token money or a "booking fee" before you have seen the home yourself.
safety_2: Check that the owner's name matches the address and the deed or electricity bill.
safety_3: Visit in daylight, and take someone with you if you can.
safety_4: Put the agreement in writing and get a receipt for every payment.
safety_5: If something feels wrong, report the listing. We look at reports within one business day.
safety_d: Never send an advance or token money before visiting. If something feels wrong, report the listing.
safety_t: See the home before you pay
saved_empty: You haven't saved any homes yet. Press Save on a home you like.
signin_note: We don't send codes to your phone. If you forget your password, contact support.
signin_why_post: Sign in to post a property.
stale_listing: This listing changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
submitted_d: Your listing goes live once a moderator approves it. You'll see the result on My listings.
support_channel: The contact channel will be listed here before launch.
support_d: Contact our support team with questions, complaints or a forgotten password. For a password reset we confirm your name, number and listings on a call, then give you a reset link.
suspended: This account is suspended. Contact support.
t_approved: Approved. The listing is now live.
t_changes: The owner has been asked for changes.
t_hidden: The listing is hidden from search.
t_password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
t_paused: Paused. It is hidden from search.
t_reconfirmed: Confirmed. It stays in search for another 30 days.
t_renewed: Renewed. It is in search for 30 days.
t_rented: Marked as rented and removed from search.
t_reset_done: Password set. Sign in with your new password.
t_reset_issued: Reset link created. Send it to the user. It works for 24 hours.
t_saved_live: Changes saved. The listing is still live.
t_unhidden: The listing is back in search.
terms_1: Only owners may post. Broker listings and fake listings are not allowed.
terms_2: Owners are responsible for keeping listing details, especially rent and costs, accurate.
terms_3: BasaChai does not check advertisers or homes. See the home yourself before any payment.
terms_4: We may hide listings or suspend accounts that break these rules.

two_factor_code_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
